note: Planning ledger, not an executable request schema or implementation evidence. Checkpoints map onto the authoritative B0-B7 roadmap.

requirements.acceptance: Seed/environment baseline and remaining B0 dispositions recorded; historical checks not relabelled
Strict deterministic component/composition/evidence contracts reject unknown fields, unsafe refs and duplicate IDs
Existing reference comparison has hand-checked inputs/results and complete adjacent data, method, analysis/render-code and reproduction views
Three structurally distinct presets use shared source and agree for unchanged analytical scope
Confirmed table interpretation and actual selection retain original records; UI/CLI agree and ambiguity is visible
Versioned multi-measure/group/ungrouped-record-count extensions have separate units and expected fixtures without implicit aggregation
Add/remove/duplicate/reorder/configure blocks and clone a genuinely new profile with explicit batch selection
Actual previews are labelled and saved confirmed recipes replay through UI and CLI
Versioned exact publication/evidence verification rejects false rehashed results/config/source and missing/extra artifacts
Failed runs preserve accepted outputs and cache-layer invalidation/validation is correct
Restricted bytes are absent from public artifacts; export omissions and replay limits are explicit
Reference data, generic snapshot/time series and a new stakeholder pass clean replay and actual human revision/review
No unexplained scientific drift; old-request compatibility or approved migration; frozen reference unchanged
Generic PDF/static parity implemented or explicitly deferred; canonical PDF/apps preserved
Parquet/extra locale-delimiter-encoding/wide-to-long support needs approved scope and fixtures before advertisement
Surveillance maps/statuses, advanced inference and forecasts require separate scientific/capability review
Scoped visual adaptation and evidence disclosure preserve semantics and receive keyboard/focus/narrow-layout review
